steps.title: Prepare tissue digestion buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 320 µL PBS, 80 µL collagenase type‑IV (Sigma C4‑BIOC), and 140 µL DNase I (Roche 10104159001) per reaction; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare debris removal solution
steps.instruction: Combine 2.7 mL debris removal buffer with 0.3 mL dilution buffer (total 3 mL) as described in the Recipes section.

steps.title: Collect and weigh brain tissues
steps.instruction: Harvest whole brains from neonatal mice (2‑day‑old) that were intracranially injected with 100 PFU ZIKV (SMGC‑1 strain) in 20 µL; collect at 10 days post‑infection. Use brains weighing 300–400 mg.

steps.title: Wash, mince, and add digestion buffer
steps.instruction: Rinse each brain with 50 mL ice‑cold autoclaved PBS (4 °C), cut into ~1 mm³ pieces with scissors, and transfer the pieces into a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing the prepared tissue digestion buffer.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion of brain tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a dry‑bath incubator at 37 °C with shaking at 250 rpm for 25 min.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation
steps.instruction: Gently pipette the digested tissue 5–10 times to break cell aggregates.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Place a 200‑mesh (70 µm) cell strainer over a 60 mm × 15 mm culture dish, add PBS to submerge the dish bottom, pour the digested suspension onto the strainer, and gently rinse with sterile PBS to collect cells.

steps.title: Debris removal and viability assessment
steps.instruction: Treat the filtered cell suspension with the prepared debris removal working solution according to the kit protocol, then evaluate cell viability and count using an automated cell counter.

steps.title: Set thermocycler for fragmentation
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler (heated lid 75 °C): 4 °C hold, 37 °C 5 min, 65 °C 30 min, 4 °C hold.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA fragmentation mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine 7 µL fragmentation buffer, 2 µL fragmentation enzyme, 10–50 ng cDNA (QC‑passed), and 1× TE to a final volume of 35 µL. Vortex briefly, keep on ice, quick‑spin, and load into PCR tubes.

steps.title: Run fragmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in the thermocycler and run steps 2–4 of the program (37 °C 5 min, 65 °C 30 min, 4 °C hold).

steps.title: Assess fragment size
steps.instruction: Check the fragmented cDNA; the main peak should be ~200–700 bp and the total library size ~500 bp.

steps.title: Set thermocycler for adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler (heated lid OFF): 4 °C hold, 20 °C 15 min, 4 °C hold.

steps.title: Prepare adapter ligation mix
steps.instruction: Combine 35 µL fragmented cDNA, 30 µL ligation mix, 1 µL ligation booster, and 2.5 µL adaptor to a total of 68.5 µL. Vortex, keep on ice, quick‑spin.

steps.title: Run adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Load the tubes into the thermocycler and run steps 2–3 of the program (20 °C 15 min, 4 °C hold), skipping the initial hold.

steps.title: Purify adapter‑ligated DNA
steps.instruction: Perform AMPure XP bead purification as follows:

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads to room temperature for 30 min.
Measure product volume; add 0.2× beads (13.7 µL for 68.5 µL product), vortex, incubate 5 min at RT.
Place tube on magnetic stand (~5 min) until solution clears; discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol (30 s each).
Air‑dry beads uncapped for ≤2 min.
Add 17 µL 0.1× TE, vortex/resuspend, incubate 5 min at RT.
Place on magnetic stand (~5 min); collect 15 µL eluate for PCR enrichment.

steps.title: Prepare PCR enrichment mix
steps.instruction: Keep the purified adapter‑ligated product on ice and combine 15 µL product, 25 µL Library Amp Mix V2, and 10 µL indexing primer mix (choose one of eight) to a total of 50 µL. Vortex, quick‑spin.

steps.title: Run PCR enrichment
steps.instruction: Program thermocycler (lid 105 °C): 98 °C 30 s; then 9–13 cycles (depending on cDNA input: 9 cycles for 50 ng, 12 for 10 ng, 13 for <10 ng) of 98 °C 10 s, 65 °C 1 min 15 s; followed by 65 °C 5 min; finish with 4 °C hold.

steps.title: Size‑select PCR product (first cleanup)
steps.instruction: Perform bead‑based size selection as follows:

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads to RT for 30 min.
Adjust PCR volume to 50 µL with nuclease‑free water if needed.
Add 0.5× beads (25 µL), vortex, incubate 5 min RT, magnetic stand ~5 min; transfer clear supernatant to a new tube (beads discarded).
Add 0.15× beads (11.25 µL) to the supernatant, vortex, incubate 5 min RT, magnetic stand ~5 min; retain the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each).
Air‑dry beads ≤2 min.
Elute with 20 µL EB buffer, incubate 5 min RT, magnetic stand ~5 min; collect eluate into a 1.5 mL tube.
Store at –20 °C or –80 °C (up to 1 month).
Reserve ~1 µL for concentration measurement and fragment‑size profiling.

steps.title: First‑round viral enrichment PCR
steps.instruction: On ice, mix 25 µL MP master mix, 2 µL ZIKV primer mix, 20 ng QC‑passed cDNA (adjust volume with nuclease‑free water), and water to 50 µL total. Vortex, quick‑spin, and run thermocycler (lid 105 °C) with program: 95 °C 15 min; 14 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 60 °C 1 min 30 s, 72 °C 1 min 30 s; final extension 72 °C 10 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Purify viral enrichment product
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product using AMPure XP beads:

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate beads to RT for 30 min.
Add 0.8× beads (40 µL) to the reaction, mix, incubate 5 min RT.
Place on magnetic stand 5 min; discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each).
Air‑dry beads, then elute with 20 µL EB buffer, incubate 5 min RT.
Magnetic stand until clear; collect eluate.
Quantify 1 µL on Qubit; concentration should exceed 1 ng/µL.

steps.title: Library construction PCR
steps.instruction: On ice, combine 25 µL HiFi PCR PreMix, 1.5 µL FocuSCOPE adapter mix, 20 ng enriched product (adjust volume with water), and nuclease‑free water to 50 µL total. Vortex, quick‑spin.

steps.title: Run library construction PCR
steps.instruction: Program thermocycler (lid 105 °C): 95 °C 3 min; 10 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 64 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Purify constructed library
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product with AMPure XP beads:

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate beads to RT for 30 min.
Add 0.8× beads (40 µL) to the reaction, mix, incubate 5 min RT.
Magnetic stand 5 min; discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each).
Air‑dry beads, then elute with 20 µL EB buffer, incubate 5 min RT.
Magnetic stand until clear; collect eluate.

steps.title: QC of final library
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µL of the purified library on a Qubit fluorometer and assess fragment‑size distribution using 2 µL (e.g., Bioanalyzer).

description: Validation of protocol This protocol has been used and validated in the following research article(s): • Zhou et al. [5]. A novel ZIKV-targeted scRNA-seq method for precise quantification of ZIKV RNA. Journal of Virology (Figures 4, 6, and 7).
